Chapter 253: Gathering Once Again in Laprarosa (1)
The boastful Bligiet, who had shouted that he would never fear pain, confessed everything he knew before even two days had passed.
[Isn't this enough? I have truly told you everything... Now release me.]
The dignity he once showed as the ego of the Sun God was nowhere to be found. Bligiet was pleading almost in a sobbing voice.
"As Sir Jin said in the beginning, you will never again step outside this world. Instead, let’s stop making you suffer now."
[...I cannot understand, Lucy. You were Araxion. How can someone like you trample on me like this? Do you not long for the time when we were one? Have you truly forgotten that longing?]
Longing.

Luci had tortured Bligiet by stimulating his longing for the 'original form'. Without any physical harm, she had devastated Bligiet's inner self just by making him remember the original form of the Sun God, in other words, Kinzelo.
[While you tortured me, you must have been in pain as well. Even though most of Araxion's power has transferred to your daughter, you couldn't have forgotten that...!]
"I have many things I long for more than that, Bluggiet. In any case, please rest easy now. Until we have a safe means to completely annihilate you."
[No, no! Lucy! H-Hey! Jin Runcandel! I am the creator of this world. I created you all! Furthermore, didn’t I relieve your guilt? Please, release me...!]
“You relieved my guilt?”
Jin stood before Bligiet.
His eyes were blazing with a vicious, ghastly light. It was because just this morning, the Zipples had once again carried out a terrorist attack on a civilian area in the Lutero Federation.

This time it was the Pailin Kingdom. Just like last time, a single bombardment completely destroyed Pailin's capital and nearby cities, and the death toll was estimated to be at least over one million.

[Th-that's right! The Authority of Regeneration that you possess. That power also originally came from me. I told you, didn't I, that with that power you can revive any number of dead mortals. Of course, there are conditions, but if you just release me…!]

“Listen carefully, Bligiet. Even if I can revive the dead with my authority, the pain they suffered does not return. Who will compensate for that? Dying painfully, engulfed in flames, losing family and loved ones before their eyes, a life where everything suddenly collapsed, how on earth can that be compensated? Is it enough to just come back to life? If they are just resurrected, is life still the same as they knew it?"
Bligiet was unable to respond and looked cautiously at Jin. It seemed like Jin would have Lucy torture him again at any moment.

"You say you're the creator of this world? The creator of this world is spouting nonsense about having to rebuild it?  Do you really know what the lives of people who live on while overcoming their own pain are like? If you created the world in this state in the first place, the only thing you should be doing is repenting. The pain you are suffering now is truly nothing."

Jin was suppressing his impulses. The urge to tear Bligiet apart. While his vision kept flickering between red and normal, Jin managed to regain control over himself. Demonization was beginning to take over.
Bligiet, unable to say anything further, lowered his head. Lucy naturally guided Jin out of the underground prison.
“Sir Jin, you endured well..”
“No, I’ve shown an unseemly side to my ancestors.”
"No, I've shown an ugly side of myself to you, ancestor."

"Not at all, so don't worry about it. By the way, we were lucky. Egos that desire reconstruction, like Bluggiet, are always thirsty with longing for the complete form. If it had been an ego of destruction instead of him, it would have been difficult to obtain information by torturing them this way. The egos of the Sun God think they are perfect beings, but they are not. In the end, they are just a single life full of flaws. Just like everyone else..."
Malugia, Araxyon.

The two beings known as the egos of destruction were now bound to Elona and Hailyn. According to the information Bligiet had confessed, there were two more egos tied to both destruction and reconstruction.
The ego of reconstruction, Nepdol, and Iloanu.
The ego of destruction, Beltian, and Kragos.
Bligiet knew the locations of Nepdol and Beltian, and once Airan’s restrictions were lifted, he had planned to awaken them.
"Nepdol is in the deep sea west of the Lutero Federation, and Beltian... Bluggiet said he's in Laprarosa."
"Yes, Sir Jin."
Naturally, both locations were completely unexpected.
Laprarosa, in particular, was shocking. To think that an ego of destruction would be sealed in the land of the Plutonian, who had been sealed for five thousand years.
Jin thought of the landscape of Laprarosa and sighed inwardly. Fortunately, Beltian had not been bound to any of the Plutonian, including Vahn. IIt was merely bound somewhere deep within Laprarosa.
“Suddenly, I have a feeling that it might not be a coincidence.”
“What do you mean?”

“After the final battle with the Red Plutonian in the Great Desert of Mitra, not only the brothers but also the entire region of Laprarosa was liberated into the human world. Perhaps the influence of that ego, Beltian, played a role in this.”
Whether that was the case or not didn't matter. As long as Beltian was an ego of 'Destruction', he was a target for elimination by the Vamel Alliance.
The search for the western sea of Lutero and Laprarosa had already begun. Especially in Laprarosa, the Plutonian were searching through the region with burning eyes.
“I’ve nearly finished interrogating Bligiet. I will just wrap it up and head straight to Laprarosa. As it is an ego of Destruction, I might be able to sense something."
Seeing the concerned look on Jin’s face, Lucy smiled and patted his shoulder.
"Sir Jin, do you happen to know this saying?"
"What is it?"
"Turn a crisis into an opportunity."
For some reason, Jin let out a small laugh.
“Who doesn’t know that?”
“Perhaps, I thought we might be able to restrain that ego named Beltian just like Bluggiet. If we use our power centered around Ameris, myself, and Lord Vahn like last time."
“Even so, didn’t you say that we can’t treat the ego of destruction the same way we treated Bligiet?”
“That’s true. But if it’s possible to bind him, we could use him. For example, we could use Beltian’s ego as a power source for the Battle God Temple.”
Jin’s eyes widened.

The Battle God Temple was originally designed as the flagship of the Golden Fleet, much like the ancient Plutonian’ floating fortress. However, the Vamel Alliance had yet to use the Battle God Temple as a flying fortress. Although the restoration of its technology was nearly complete, they couldn’t find the power source to support it.
“Is that possible?”
"It would depend on the form in which we restrain him. But one thing is for sure, it is indeed possible."
If they could use an ego of the Sun God as a power source, the Battle God Temple would become the strongest flying fortress imaginable.

It wasn’t just about increasing power. The speed at which the Tower of Stories could be tracked would change, and they would be able to prevent the merciless massacres they were committing much more easily than now.
“As you said, I hope it’s not just all bad. Let’s go find that Beltian.”

The locations of Beltian, Nepdol, Iloanu, and Kragos had to be found urgently. Whether for reconstruction, destruction, or maintenance, any of the Sun God’s egos needed to be discovered faster than the Zipple or Ganesto.
“Let’s stay strong, everyone.”
“Thank you, Lady Lucy.”
Soon, Jin headed toward the upper conference room of Tikan Palace. After hearing Lucy’s words, he felt an inexplicable sense of hope, and his previously turbulent emotions seemed to calm down.
Of course, the fundamental shock had not subsided. In just a few days, a great death, so immense it was hard to grasp, had become rampant in the world.
‘Still... Bligiet’s words aren’t completely without comfort. There were Lady Ayula’s words too. Even though terrible memories remain, it’s better than just disappearing and dying, right? For anyone.’
Just before entering the conference room, Jin came face-to-face with Gilly and Murakan, who were leaving the hallway, holding hands.
"Heup, young master."
Gilly instinctively tried to let go of Murakan’s hand, but Murakan held on tighter, pulling Gilly toward him.
"Kyakya, kid! Strawberry Pie is no longer your Strawberry Pie alone. Got it?"
“That’s always been the case, Murakan. Strawberry... no, for Gilly, you and I have always been the top priority. Gilly, don't worry about this kind of thing anymore."
“Does that mean I’m the top priority between the two of us?”
“Sir Murakan, that’s a bit…”
"Th-that's a bit, you say?"
"Just now, I was a little embarrassed, so it just slipped out. Actually, I should have told you first, Young Master, before becoming Sir Murakan's lover."
Suddenly, Jin felt an indescribable sense of gratitude toward the two of them.
Even though terrible things were happening in this world, and it all felt like it was because of his regression.
Gilly and Murakan, who had always been with him since the moment he regressed, seemed to have found happiness.
[Oh, that’s a nice picture.]
While Jin was smiling at Gilly, a small steel dimensional gate suddenly formed in front of the conference room.
"Now you're coming and going as if it's your own home, Orgal. You're not a member of our coalition yet."
[Tsk, acting so petty. Do you even know what kind of information this great one has brought?]
Orgal looked at Jin with a confident face. Jin shook his head and waited for his next words.
[Ainas Caligo. That woman, and Bubar, Have I ever explained how incredible they are?]
"We were also aware of Ainas and Pirope's dream abilities."
[Those two did it, Jin Runcandel. They captured the meeting between Rokia and Kelliark, piercing through their dreams. I told you, right? Rokia was definitely going to meet with Kelliark.]
